text: Introduction This project is undertaken by School of Energy and Power Engineering of WUT. The school has majors of Power Engineering, Marine Machinery Operation Engineering, Marine Engine Engineering, and Thermal Power Engineering, also has System Simulation and Control and Intelligent Transportation System (ITS) Research Center. It has founded four research facilities, the key laboratory on Power Machinery Engineering directed by the Ministry of Transport, the Energy Efficiency Training Center under direction of the Ministry of Transport, China Classification Society (CCS) measurement center of engine emission and China Classification Society (CCS) measurement center of lubricating oil. Research Orientation Advanced technical personnel having knowledge of principle of mechanics and marine engine system, etc., fitting in with training, issuing certificates of international seamen and STCW78/95, possessing job qualifications for second assistant engineers of ships of A class, and being able to embark on works like controlling and maintaining turbines, editorial supervision of ships and special inspection of work. Bachelors' Degree for Class Formed Only by International Students are required to have as least 12 students in one program.
